scope: Qualitative triage of the 29 waiting signals at 08:34 Warsaw. It is not a calibrated probability ranking and does not admit or reject a candidate. Queue order, V3, fit settings, priors, active fits and scientific gates are unchanged.
apparent_size_method: Rp/R_earth = 109.076 * declared stellar radius in solar units * sqrt(local PSF_FLAT depth). It is a crude apparent size estimate, not a fitted or grazing/dilution-corrected physical radius.
method: Read existing stellar/scene records and fixed-clock local measurements. For the seven shallow signals and KIC4540746, rerun unchanged vetting_periodic measurement functions at the already supplied clocks on authenticated original PSF_FLAT FITS arrays. Inspect full-phase median folds of all small-apparent-size restored signals. Do not treat broad variability as a definitive false-positive classification or local diagnostic S/N as identical to the final model S/N.
